evidenceNotes.observation: 933c2949 is the merge base and an ancestor of the reviewed head; trees match. The canonical command produced 11947 bytes and SHA-256 afba6912ead4a12ad7edcd1d232ff2d3697fc6b357696d2d7f69ed691f5dd1e5, byte-identical to the stored 12-section no-renames patch. Rename-aware logical stats remain the authentic PR totals of 10 files, 135 insertions, and 6 deletions.

The reviewed patch makes non-first import deletion preserve leading comments. Organize imports already replaces the first import with a rebuilt list containing those comments and then deletes subsequent originals through the generalized deletion path, so their trivia is emitted a second time and repeated saves can grow the duplicate.

Issue 38507 records successive comment duplication. The repair introduces explicit configurable deletion for subsequent organize-import nodes and the PR adds the SortComments unit input and accepted baseline, closing the same root.
